items.title: Rodri ready for 'excitement again' after Barca complete £65m deal
items.description: Barcelona sign Spain midfielder Rodri, the player of the 2026 World Cup, from Manchester City after a trophy-laden seven years with the Premier League club.

items.title: Aston Villa agree deal for West Ham's Wan-Bissaka
items.description: Aston Villa agree to sign West Ham defender Aaron Wan-Bissaka on an initial loan deal with an obligation to buy at the end of the season.

items.title: Fifa sacking 'deeply troubling' - Uefa executive
items.description: Fifa's decision to dismiss senior executive Kevin Lamour following his criticism of president Gianni Infantino sends a "deeply troubling message to all of us seeking change", says UEFA vice-president Laura McAllister.

items.title: Charlton helping police after man found dead at their stadium
Celtic out to erase Kairat pain as O'Neill eyes Champions League return
items.description: Twelve months ago, Celtic's humiliating Champions League exit to Kairat Almaty set the tone for a campaign of chaos. Martin O'Neill is determined to erase that pain.

items.title: Premier League chief Masters says Fifa self-destructed over World Cup plan
items.description: Premier League chief executive Richard Masters has criticised Fifa president Gianni Infantino's World Cup sell-off plan, saying the organisation has "pressed the self-destruct button" by delivering "a self-inflicted wound".

items.title: Aston Villa latest: Deal agreed to sign West Ham defender Wan-Bissaka
New Celtic signings unlikely before LASK tie - O'Neill
items.description: Celtic manager Martin O'Neill does not anticipate any new arrivals before Wednesday's Champions League play-off first leg at home to LASK and insists he would be happy for Reo Hatate to stay.

items.title: New Celtic signings unlikely before LASK tie but O'Neill happy for Hatate to stay
items.description: Celtic manager Martin O'Neill does not anticipate any new arrivals before Wednesday's Champions League play-off first leg at home to LASK and insists he would be happy for Reo Hatate to stay.

items.title: O'Neill: Celtic should aspire to win the Champions League
items.description: Martin O'Neill believes Celtic should "aspire" to win the Champions League ahead of their play-off round qualifier against Austrian champions LASK.

items.title: Retaining top talent a challenge - Everton chief Kinnear
items.description: Retaining top talent is a challenge for established Premier League clubs even when they are performing well, says Everton chief executive officer Angus Kinnear.
